integrity: The analytic proof uses walk locality, explicit entry-polynomial classes and sign arguments. Reproducible exact-rational symbolic checks are included, but independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to one completed classical RK4 step for finite, simple, unweighted graphs of maximum degree at most two, including disjoint unions. It does not address nonuniform rates, internal RK4 stages, arbitrary graph degrees, or nonlinear equations.
title: Exact RK4 positivity horizons on networks of maximum degree two
